an5.90:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcime bhikkhave dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattanti.
an5.90:1.3: idha bhikkhave sekho bhikkhu bahukicco hoti bahukaraṇīyo vyatto kiṃkaraṇīyesu.
an5.90:1.5: ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattati.
an5.90:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave sekho bhikkhu appamattakena kammena divasaṃ atināmeti.
an5.90:2.3: ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattati.
an5.90:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave sekho bhikkhu saṃsaṭṭho viharati gahaṭṭhapabbajitehi ananulomikena gihīsaṃsaggena.
an5.90:3.3: ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattati.
an5.90:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave sekho bhikkhu atikālena gāmaṃ pavisati, atidivā paṭikkamati.
an5.90:4.3: ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattati.
an5.90:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave sekho bhikkhu yāyaṃ kathā ābhisallekhikā cetovivaraṇasappāyā-seyyathīdaṃ:
an5.90:5.2: appicchakathā santuṭṭhikathā pavivekakathā asaṃsaggakathā viriyāramhakathā sīlakathā samādhikathā paññākathā vimuttikathā vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā, evarūpāya kathāya na nikāmalābhī hoti kicchalābhī kasiralābhī.
an5.90:5.3: riñcati paṭisallānaṃ. nānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ ceto samathaṃ.
an5.90:5.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave pañcamo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattati.
an5.90:5.5: ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattanti.
an5.90:6.1: pañcime bhikkhave dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattanti.
an5.90:6.3: idha bhikkhave sekho bhikkhu na bahukicco hoti na bahukaraṇīyo viyatto kiṃ karaṇīyesu.
an5.90:6.4: na riñcati paṭisallānaṃ. anuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ.
an5.90:6.5: ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattati.
an5.90:7.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave sekho bhikkhu na appamattakena kammena divasaṃ atināmeti,
an5.90:7.2: na riñcati paṭisallānaṃ. anuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ.
an5.90:7.3: ayaṃ cakkhave dutiyo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattati.
an5.90:8.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave sekho bhikkhu asaṃsaṭṭho viharati gahaṭṭhapabbajitehi ananulomikena gihīsaṃsaggena.
an5.90:8.2: na riñcati paṭisallānaṃ. anuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ.
an5.90:8.3: ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattati.
an5.90:9.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave sekho nātikālena gāmaṃ pavisati, nātidivā paṭikkamati.
an5.90:9.2: na riñcati paṭisallānaṃ. anuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ.
an5.90:9.3: ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattati.
an5.90:10.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave sekho bhikkhu yāyaṃ kathā ābhisallekhikā cetovivaraṇasappāyā-seyyathīdaṃ:
an5.90:10.2: appicchakathā santuṭṭhikathā pavivekakathā asaṃsaggakathā viriyāramhakathā sīlakathā samādhikathā paññākathā vimuttikathā vimuttiñāṇassakathā, evarūpāya kathāya nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an5.90:10.3: na riñcati paṭisallānaṃ. anuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ.
an5.90:10.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave pañcamo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattati.
an5.90:10.5: ime kho bhikkhave pañcadhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattati.
